### Accidental Music Club @ NCF Cultural Co-op, Ballina

![Accidental Music Club](accidental.jpg)

**Tuesday February 17th** /
**7:30pm – 10:30pm**

This event is a test run for a new sound improvisation club. Guests are invited to bring along non-musical objects and explore sound-making together through listening, experimentation, and playful collaboration. No musical experience is needed—just curiosity and a willingness to try something different.

**Free event!**

Hosted by Jonathan Crean
